title: AlmaLinux OS 9 /etc/shadow- file must be owned by root.
check_content:
Verify the ownership of the "/etc/shadow-" file with the following command:

$ stat -c "%U %n" /etc/shadow- 

root /etc/shadow- 

If "/etc/shadow-" file does not have an owner of "root", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Change the owner of the file /etc/shadow- to root by running the following command:

$ chown root /etc/shadow-
VulnDiscussion: The "/etc/shadow-" file is a backup file of "/etc/shadow", and as such, contains the list of local system accounts and password hashes. Protection of this file is critical for system security.
